Title: USPS® ZIP Code Boundaries | PostalPro
Description: USPS® ZIP Code Boundaries is a national ZIP Code™ map utilizing USPS delivery address and location information to ensure accurate boundaries. Temporal fluctuation is based on changing delivery distribution for new or changed delivery locations. Many industries, such as mapping, mailing, marketing, insurance, real estate, logistics, navigation, and transportation can benefit from access to the ZIP Code boundary data.
